mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO zabbix.sla_review_event (period_month, system_level, system_name, down_start, down_end, owner_name) VALUES (#{periodMonth}, #{systemLevel}, #{systemName}, #{downStart}, #{downEnd}, #{ownerName})
mapper.update: UPDATE zabbix.sla_review_event SET down_end = #{newDownEnd}, exclude_time = CASE WHEN TRIM(IFNULL(count_sla, '')) = '否' THEN #{newDownEnd} ELSE exclude_time END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, fault_category, fault_subcategory, fault_desc, count_sla, sort_order FROM zabbix.sla_fault_category ORDER BY sort_order, id

SELECT id, period_month, system_level, system_name, down_start, down_end, owner_name, fault_category, fault_subcategory, fault_desc, count_sla, resolution_process, root_cause, improvement, created_at, updated_at FROM zabbix.sla_review_event
ORDER BY down_start DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT id, period_month, system_level, system_name, down_start, down_end, exclude_time, owner_name, fault_category, fault_subcategory, fault_desc, count_sla, resolution_process, root_cause, improvement, created_at, updated_at FROM zabbix.sla_review_event WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, period_month, system_level, system_name, down_start, down_end, exclude_time, owner_name, fault_category, fault_subcategory, fault_desc, count_sla, resolution_process, root_cause, improvement, created_at, updated_at FROM zabbix.sla_review_event WHERE count_sla IN ('是', '否') ORDER BY down_start, id
SELECT DISTINCT owner_name FROM zabbix.sla_review_event WHERE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM zabbix.sla_review_event WHERE AND system_level = #{systemLevel}

SELECT CASE WHEN owner_name IS NULL OR TRIM(owner_name) = '' THEN '' ELSE owner_name END AS ownerName, COUNT(*) AS count FROM zabbix.sla_review_event WHERE GROUP BY CASE WHEN owner_name IS NULL OR TRIM(owner_name) = '' THEN '' ELSE owner_name END ORDER BY count DESC, ownerName ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE zabbix.sla_review_event SET fault_category = #{faultCategory}, fault_subcategory = #{faultSubcategory}, fault_desc = #{faultDesc}, count_sla = #{countSla}, resolution_process = #{resolutionProcess}, root_cause = #{rootCause}, improvement = #{improvement}, exclude_time = CASE WHEN #{countSla} = '是' THEN DATE_ADD(down_start, INTERVAL 1 SECOND) WHEN #{countSla} = '否' THEN down_end ELSE NULL END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE zabbix.sla_review_event SET exclude_time = CASE WHEN count_sla = '是' THEN DATE_ADD(down_start, INTERVAL 1 SECOND) WHEN count_sla = '否' THEN down_end ELSE NULL END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
